identity_limits: Whole clusters are not individual proteins; candidate edges are not exact experimental assignments.
Gene symbol filters miss unnamed entries and produce unrelated homonyms.
Three references are fragments; O52073 and Q06893 have sequence version 2, not an assumed original experimental sequence.
VanB Q06893 is a V583-associated reference, not the BM4281 subject of PMID:8654967.
O52073 retains a vanE annotation in Paenibacillus; it is not silently merged with enterococcal VanE.
VanM reference CP039730 and its sample belong to separate ZY2 context, not Efm-HS0661.
VanO source Rhodococcus equi appears in taxonomy otherNames with authority text; the current reference name is Rhodococcus hoagii.
Archive contig-set, nucleotide, sample and project identifiers are not assembly assignments.
No-hit citation searches and excluded homonyms do not establish biological absence.
N00-410 in the publication title and N00-0410 in UniProt strain comments remain unreconciled source strings.
VanO source RE-S7B and UniProt S7B are not silently treated as an exact strain identifier crosswalk.
Whole-record review and primary review of the remaining papers are still open.

15980329.finding: Source distinguishes a second ligase from VanF; the shared citation does not make Q9ZFK2 a VanF assignment.

19414574.finding: Native vancomycin resistance accompanies the characterized DSY3690 ligase. Its Q24R63 reference is distinct from DSY1579/Q24X74, the biochemical comparator; neither reference identifies a modified experimental protein.
19414574.qualitative_comparator: Source describes intermediate teicoplanin resistance, not the same phenotype as vancomycin.

20733041.finding: Native vancomycin resistance and vanM occurrence are linked; B8XGS3 binds Efm-HS0661 to FJ349556 through ACL82961.1. Separate ZY2 context does not identify the original isolate genome.
20733041.qualitative_comparator: Efm-HS08257 has a discordant teicoplanin phenotype; cluster presence does not determine every glycopeptide phenotype.

24342631.finding: Source reports context-dependent resistance in an environmental isolate and deposit KF478993. The UniProt citation query returns entries without van gene symbols; V5KW92 is annotated ddl.
